class.name: CgameWorldSharding
class.brief_description: Plans which server owns which world region and how players move between them.
class.description: [CgameWorldSharding] maps a grid of square regions onto zone servers. It assigns regions with a greedy longest-processing-time rule ([method assign_initial]), rebalances them when one server is clearly hotter than another ([method rebalance]), reports which neighbouring servers need a ghost copy of an entity near a border ([method ghost_servers]) and runs an idempotent four-step player handoff ([method begin_transfer], [method send_state], [method ack_transfer], [method release_transfer]). The planner holds no network code: the caller moves the bytes and reports the results. Every step of the handoff may be repeated safely, so a duplicated or replayed message never changes ownership twice.

method.name: setup
method.description: Resizes the grid and resets [member region_owner] to server 0. At least one server is kept.

method.name: region_of
method.description: Returns the index of the region containing [param pos]. Positions outside the grid clamp to the nearest edge region.

method.name: owner_at
method.description: Returns the server owning the region at [param pos].

method.name: server_loads
method.description: Sums the per-region [param loads] for every server and returns one float per server. Missing entries count as zero.

method.name: assign_initial
method.description: Assigns regions heaviest first to the least loaded server (ties: fewest regions).

method.name: rebalance
method.description: Moves regions from the hottest to the coldest server while that strictly lowers the peak load, up to [member max_moves] times. Does nothing inside the [member imbalance_ratio] band. Returns [code]{region, from, to}[/code] dictionaries and applies them.

method.name: claim_entity
method.description: Records [param server] as the owner of an entity.

method.name: owner_of
method.description: Returns the owning server of an entity, or [code]-1[/code] if unknown.

method.name: entities_on
method.description: Returns the ids of all entities owned by [param server].

method.name: ghost_servers
method.description: Returns the sorted servers other than [param owner] whose regions fall within [member border_margin] of [param pos].

method.name: handoff_needed
method.description: Returns the server the player should be handed to, or [code]-1[/code] while the player is still within [member handoff_hysteresis] of a region owned by [param current_server].

method.name: track_player
method.description: Starts tracking a player as stable on [param server].

method.name: update_player
method.description: Moves a tracked player and returns [code]{ghosts, handoff_to}[/code]. [code]handoff_to[/code] is [code]-1[/code] unless a handoff is due and the player is not frozen.

method.name: begin_transfer
method.description: Freezes the player and records the handoff. Returns [param transfer_id], or an empty string if rejected (unknown or already frozen player, same server). A repeated id is ignored and returns the id.

method.name: send_state
method.description: Stores the player state to send and moves the transfer to [code]"transferring"[/code]. Idempotent past that step; returns [code]false[/code] for unknown or aborted transfers.

method.name: ack_transfer
method.description: The destination confirms it has the state. Idempotent.

method.name: release_transfer
method.description: The source releases authority: ownership flips to the destination and the player becomes stable again. Only valid after [method ack_transfer]; idempotent once done.

method.name: abort_transfer
method.description: Cancels an unfinished transfer and unfreezes the player on the source. Returns [code]false[/code] for finished, aborted or unknown transfers.

members.member: Edge length of one square region.
Ghost replication distance: servers whose regions lie within this distance of a position receive a ghost.
A player must be this far inside the new region before [method handoff_needed] reports a handoff.
[method rebalance] only acts when the hottest server's load exceeds the coldest server's load times this ratio.
Maximum number of region moves per [method rebalance] call.
Owning server of every region, indexed [code]row * cols + col[/code].
Owning server of every claimed entity id.
Tracked players keyed by id: [code]pos[/code], [code]state[/code] ([code]"stable"[/code] or [code]"frozen"[/code]), [code]transfer[/code] and [code]ghosts[/code].
Handoffs keyed by transfer id: [code]player[/code], [code]from[/code], [code]to[/code], [code]state[/code] and [code]payload[/code].
